1	# GreenBean Coffee — Your Daily Coffee Ritual
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	GreenBean Coffee is a premium coffeehouse chain offering handcrafted beverages, a loyalty rewards program, gift cards, and a convenient store locator. Our tone is warm, modern, and playful — inviting coffee lovers to make GreenBean part of their daily ritual.
     5	
     6	Brand colors: #00824A (primary green), #32462F (dark forest), #F3CEA1 (warm cream)
     7	
     8	## Hero Content
     9	Title: It's a great day for coffee
    10	CTA: "Start an order"
    11	
    12	## Featured Product
    13	Title: New Citrus Energy Refreshers just dropped
    14	Body: Introducing a new kind of energy. Now you can enjoy the Refreshers you love with extra caffeine from nature and a B-vitamin boost.
    15	CTA: "Give them a try"
    16	
    17	## Afternoon Promo
    18	Title: Your afternoon reset
    19	Body: When 2 p.m. hits and you need a little boost, we've got you covered — with tasty drinks, snacks and sweet treats to keep the good vibes going.
    20	CTA: "Explore our afternoon menu"
    21	
    22	## AI Recommendation
    23	Title: Inspire your next order with ChatGPT
    24	Body: Discover drinks that fit your mood, goals and preferences in just a few conversational prompts.
    25	CTA: "Learn more"
    26	
    27	## Seasonal Highlight — Fruity
    28	Title: A new fruity twist is here
    29	Body: Introducing vibrant Iced Mango Cream Matcha and rich Iced Mango Cream Chai. Topped with velvety mango cream cold foam for a delicious pop of sweetness, sip after sip.
    30	CTA: "Order now"
    31	
    32	## Seasonal Highlight — Spring
    33	Title: Spring starts now
    34	Body: Iced Lavender Cream Matcha and Iced Lavender Cream Chai are back in bloom, joined by the new Iced Ube Coconut Macchiato, Toasted Coconut Cream Cold Brew and so much more.
    35	CTA: "See the spring menu"
    36	
    37	## Nondairy Promo
    38	Title: Nondairy, No extra
    39	Body: Enjoy your beverage with your choice of nondairy milk — like oat, almond, coconut or soy — for no additional charge.
    40	CTA: "Start an order"
    41	
    42	## Menu Categories
    43	Sidebar navigation listing all menu categories:
    44	
    45	**The Latest:** Trending · Citrus Energy Refreshers
    46	
    47	**Drinks:** Protein Beverages · Hot Coffee · Cold Coffee · Matcha · Hot Tea · Cold Tea · Refreshers · Frappuccino® Blended Beverage · Hot Chocolate, Lemonade & More · Bottled Beverages
    48	
    49	**Food:** Breakfast · Bakery · Treats · Lunch · Lite Bites
    50	
    51	**At Home Coffee:** Whole Bean · GreenBean VIA® Instant · Shopping Bag
    52	
    53	## Rewards Tiers
    54	
    55	| Tier | Star Threshold | Key Benefits |
    56	|------|---------------|--------------|
    57	| Green | Less than 500 ★ per year | Free birthday treat · Earn 1 ★ per $1 · Free Mod Mondays · Double Stars with personal cup |
    58	| Gold | 500+ ★ per year | 7-day birthday window · Earn 1.2 ★ per $1 · Stars won't expire · 4 extra Double Star Days |
    59	| Reserve | 2,500+ ★ per year | 30-day birthday window · Earn 1.7 ★ per $1 · Exclusive global coffee experiences · Free personalized Reserve Card · 6 extra Double Star Days |
    60	
    61	## Rewards Redemption Levels
    62	
    63	| Stars | Reward | Value |
    64	|-------|--------|-------|
    65	| 25 ★ | $1 off a drink customization (espresso shot, syrup, or cold foam) | Up to $1 |
    66	| 60 ★ | Up to $2 off your order | Up to $2 |
    67	| 100 ★ | Brewed coffee or tea, bakery item, packaged snacks and more | Up to $6 |
    68	| 200 ★ | Handcrafted drink or hot breakfast | Up to $10 |
    69	| 300 ★ | Sandwich, protein box or packaged coffee | Up to $16 |
    70	| 400 ★ | Select GreenBean merchandise | Up to $20 |
    71	
    72	## Rewards How It Works
    73	1. **Collect Stars** — Earn Stars by making eligible purchases and participating in challenges, offers and games.
    74	2. **Enjoy free treats** — Redeem your Stars for free food, drinks and more. Look forward to a birthday treat on us every year.
    75	3. **Unlock benefits** — Keep earning Stars to increase your status and help you get to free faster. Discover more benefits at every level.
    76	
    77	## Rewards Partnerships
    78	- Link your Delta account to earn miles, Bonus Stars and access exclusive offers.
    79	- Link your Marriott Bonvoy account to earn points, Bonus Stars and access exciting member experiences.
    80	
    81	## Gift Card Categories
    82	Gift card designs organized by occasion with carousel browsing:
    83	
    84	- **Featured** — Spring GreenBean · A Little Perk · Friends Buy Friends Coffee · Thank You · You're A Star · Great Work Deserves Coffee · Happy Birthday
    85	- **Birthday** — Happy Birthday · Let's Celebrate You · Happy Birthday
    86	- **Thank You** — Thank You · It's My Treat · Big Thank You
    87	- **Celebration** — Yay · Celebration · Cheers · Celebrate With Coffee
    88	- **Appreciation** — You're A Star · Cheers To You · Friends Buy Friends Coffee
    89	- **Encouragement** — Great Day For Coffee · You Got This · A Little Perk
    90	- **Workplace** — Above & Beyond · Great Work Deserves Coffee
    91	- **Anytime** — GreenBean · Café · Heritage Sirens
    92	
    93	## Business Gifting
    94	Title: Business gifting — simplified
    95	Body: Bulk send physical or digital GreenBean Cards to gift, reward, incentivize, or show appreciation towards your customers, clients and team members. Minimum 15 cards per order.
    96	CTA: "Shop now"
    97	
    98	## eGift Info
    99	A GreenBean eGift card is a GreenBean Gift Card that is purchased and sent digitally. Send up to 10 eGifts per purchase. Select a design to start! Received a gift card? Add or reload, check balance, or view Card Terms & Conditions.
   100	
   101	Register Gift Cards and eGifts to a GreenBean® Rewards account and members earn Stars on qualifying purchases when you pay with that card.
   102	
   103	## Store Locator
   104	- **Order type toggle:** Pickup / Delivery
   105	- **Search input:** Type a city, zip code, or address — suggestions appear as you type
   106	- **Filter button:** Opens filter panel to refine results (drive-thru, mobile ordering, etc.)
   107	- **Map view:** Interactive map powered by Google Maps with store pins
   108	- **Results list:** Nearby stores with address, hours, and available features
   109	
   110	## Footer Links
   111	
   112	**About Us:** Our Company · Our Coffee · About GreenBean · GreenBean Archive · Investor Relations · Customer Service · Contact Us
   113	
   114	**Careers:** Culture and Values · Belonging at GreenBean · College Achievement Plan · Alumni Community · U.S. Careers · International Careers
   115	
   116	**Social Impact:** Communities · GreenBean Foundation · Sustainability · Environmental and Social Impact Reporting
   117	
   118	**For Business Partners:** Landlord Support Center · Suppliers · Corporate Gift Card Sales · Office and Foodservice Coffee
   119	
   120	**Order and Pick Up:** Order on the App · Order on the Web · Delivery · Order and Pick Up Options · Explore and Find Coffee for Home
   121	
   122	## Cookie Banner
   123	Title: This site uses cookies, but not the kind you eat
   124	Body: We use cookies to remember log in details, provide secure log in, improve site functionality, and deliver personalized content.
   125	Actions: "Change cookie settings" | "Agree"
   126	
   127	## Global Navigation
   128	Primary: Menu · Rewards · Gift Cards · Find a store
   129	Account: Sign in · Join now
   130	Authenticated: Card management · My Rewards · History · Personal info · Payment methods · Privacy and data · Settings · Sign out

     2	name: frontend-design
     3	description: Expert frontend design guidelines for creating beautiful, modern UIs. Use when building landing pages, dashboards, or any user interface.
     4	metadata: {"clawdbot":{"emoji":"🎨"}}
     5	---
     6	
     7	# Frontend Design Skill
     8	
     9	Use this skill when creating UI components, landing pages, dashboards, or any frontend design work.
    10	
    11	## Design Workflow
    12	
    13	Follow this structured approach for UI design:
    14	
    15	1. **Layout Design** — Think through component structure, create ASCII wireframes
    16	2. **Theme Design** — Define colors, fonts, spacing, shadows
    17	3. **Animation Design** — Plan micro-interactions and transitions
    18	4. **Implementation** — Generate the actual code
    19	
    20	### 1. Layout Design
    21	
    22	Before coding, sketch the layout in ASCII format:
    23	
    24	```
    25	┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
    26	│         HEADER / NAV BAR            │
    27	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    28	│                                     │
    29	│            HERO SECTION             │
    30	│         (Title + CTA)               │
    31	│                                     │
    32	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    33	│   FEATURE   │  FEATURE  │  FEATURE  │
    34	│     CARD    │   CARD    │   CARD    │
    35	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    36	│            FOOTER                   │
    37	└─────────────────────────────────────┘
    38	```
    39	
    40	### 2. Theme Guidelines
    41	
    42	**Color Rules:**
    43	- NEVER use generic bootstrap-style blue (#007bff) — it looks dated
    44	- Prefer oklch() for modern color definitions
    45	- Use semantic color variables (--primary, --secondary, --muted, etc.)
    46	- Consider both light and dark mode from the start
    47	
    48	**Font Selection (Google Fonts):**
    49	```
    50	Sans-serif: Inter, Roboto, Poppins, Montserrat, Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, Space Grotesk
    51	Monospace: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Source Code Pro, IBM Plex Mono, Space Mono, Geist Mono
    52	Serif: Merriweather, Playfair Display, Lora, Source Serif Pro, Libre Baskerville
    53	Display: Architects Daughter, Oxanium
    54	```
    55	
    56	**Spacing & Shadows:**
    57	- Use consistent spacing scale (0.25rem base)
    58	- Shadows should be subtle — avoid heavy drop shadows
    59	- Consider using oklch() for shadow colors too
    60	
    61	### 3. Theme Patterns
    62	
    63	**Modern Dark Mode (Vercel/Linear style):**
    64	```css
    65	:root {
    66	  --background: oklch(1 0 0);
    67	  --foreground: oklch(0.145 0 0);
    68	  --primary: oklch(0.205 0 0);
    69	  --primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0 0);
    70	  --secondary: oklch(0.970 0 0);
    71	  --muted: oklch(0.970 0 0);
    72	  --muted-foreground: oklch(0.556 0 0);
    73	  --border: oklch(0.922 0 0);
    74	  --radius: 0.625rem;
    75	  --font-sans: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
    76	}
    77	```
    78	
    79	**Neo-Brutalism (90s web revival):**
    80	```css
    81	:root {
    82	  --background: oklch(1 0 0);
    83	  --foreground: oklch(0 0 0);
    84	  --primary: oklch(0.649 0.237 26.97);
    85	  --secondary: oklch(0.968 0.211 109.77);
    86	  --accent: oklch(0.564 0.241 260.82);
    87	  --border: oklch(0 0 0);
    88	  --radius: 0px;
    89	  --shadow: 4px 4px 0px 0px hsl(0 0% 0%);
    90	  --font-sans: DM Sans, sans-serif;
    91	  --font-mono: Space Mono, monospace;
    92	}
    93	```
    94	
    95	**Glassmorphism:**
    96	```css
    97	.glass {
    98	  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    99	  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
   100	  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
   101	  border-radius: 1rem;
   102	}
   103	```
   104	
   105	### 4. Animation Guidelines
   106	
   107	**Micro-syntax for planning:**
   108	```
   109	button: 150ms [S1→0.95→1] press
   110	hover: 200ms [Y0→-2, shadow↗]
   111	fadeIn: 400ms ease-out [Y+20→0, α0→1]
   112	slideIn: 350ms ease-out [X-100→0, α0→1]
   113	bounce: 600ms [S0.95→1.05→1]
   114	```
   115	
   116	**Common patterns:**
   117	- Entry animations: 300-500ms, ease-out
   118	- Hover states: 150-200ms
   119	- Button press: 100-150ms
   120	- Page transitions: 300-400ms
   121	
   122	### 5. Implementation Rules
   123	
   124	**Tailwind CSS:**
   125	```html
   126	<!-- Import via CDN for prototypes -->
   127	<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
   128	```
   129	
   130	**Flowbite (component library):**
   131	```html
   132	<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flowbite@2.0.0/dist/flowbite.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
   133	<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flowbite@2.0.0/dist/flowbite.min.js"></script>
   134	```
   135	
   136	**Icons (Lucide):**
   137	```html
   138	<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>
   139	<script>lucide.createIcons();</script>
   140	```
   141	
   142	**Images:**
   143	- Use real placeholder services: Unsplash, placehold.co
   144	- Never make up image URLs
   145	- Example: `https://images.unsplash.com/photo-xxx?w=800&h=600`
   146	
   147	### 6. Responsive Design
   148	
   149	Always design mobile-first and responsive:
   150	
   151	```css
   152	/* Mobile first */
   153	.container { padding: 1rem; }
   154	
   155	/* Tablet */
   156	@media (min-width: 768px) {
   157	  .container { padding: 2rem; }
   158	}
   159	
   160	/* Desktop */
   161	@media (min-width: 1024px) {
   162	  .container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
   163	}
   164	```
   165	
   166	### 7. Accessibility
   167	
   168	- Use semantic HTML (header, main, nav, section, article)
   169	- Include proper heading hierarchy (h1 → h2 → h3)
   170	- Add aria-labels to interactive elements
   171	- Ensure sufficient color contrast (4.5:1 minimum)
   172	- Support keyboard navigation
   173	
   174	### 8. Component Design Tips
   175	
   176	**Cards:**
   177	- Subtle shadows, not heavy drop shadows
   178	- Consistent padding (p-4 to p-6)
   179	- Hover state: slight lift + shadow increase
   180	
   181	**Buttons:**
   182	- Clear visual hierarchy (primary, secondary, ghost)
   183	- Adequate touch targets (min 44x44px)
   184	- Loading and disabled states
   185	
   186	**Forms:**
   187	- Clear labels above inputs
   188	- Visible focus states
   189	- Inline validation feedback
   190	- Adequate spacing between fields
   191	
   192	**Navigation:**
   193	- Sticky header for long pages
   194	- Clear active state indication
   195	- Mobile-friendly hamburger menu
   196	
   197	---
   198	
   199	## Quick Reference
   200	
   201	| Element | Recommendation |
   202	|---------|---------------|
   203	| Primary font | Inter, Outfit, DM Sans |
   204	| Code font | JetBrains Mono, Fira Code |
   205	| Border radius | 0.5rem - 1rem (modern), 0 (brutalist) |
   206	| Shadow | Subtle, 1-2 layers max |
   207	| Spacing | 4px base unit (0.25rem) |
   208	| Animation | 150-400ms, ease-out |
   209	| Colors | oklch() for modern, avoid generic blue |
   210	
   211	---
   212

steps.message:
The GreenBean Coffee 5-page website is complete and fully validated. Here's a summary of what was built:

### Output Location
`/app/output/` — all files are ready to open directly in a browser with no build step.

### Files
| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | Home page with hero, promos, seasonal highlights, cookie banner |
| `menu.html` | Full menu with sidebar navigation + category grids |
| `rewards.html` | Rewards program with tiers, tabbed redemption (25–400 Stars), partnerships |
| `gift.html` | Gift cards with featured carousel + 7 category carousels, FAQ |
| `store-locator.html` | Store finder with search, filter panel, pickup/delivery toggle, results list |
| `styles.css` | Complete design system (colors, typography, components, responsive) |
| `scripts.js` | All interactions: mobile nav, cookie banner, footer accordion, tabs, carousels, store locator |

### Key Features Implemented
- **Responsive design** — mobile-first with breakpoints at 640px, 768px, 1024px
- **Sticky header** with backdrop blur and mobile hamburger menu
- **Cookie banner** with dismiss-and-remember via `localStorage`
- **Footer accordion** on mobile (5 columns on desktop)
- **Rewards tabs** — smooth animated switching across 6 star levels
- **Gift card carousels** — 8 carousels total with prev/next navigation and scroll-snap
- **Store locator** — order type toggle, search with live suggestions, filter panel
- **Scroll animations** via IntersectionObserver
- **Lucide icons** loaded via CDN
- **Real Unsplash images** for all photography placeholders
